description: Two-mix glue starter. Shallowest reduction in the set; loudness via balance not depth.
name: comp-2mix
notes: Precondition: Mixbus master/group selected in Cubase, Compressor slot 0 per opencode/reference/comp-2mix.md.
Send in listed order with unique numeric id per request to POST http://localhost:3001/rpc.
Response param field shows resolved Cubase title; on Parameter not found, shorten spelling.
Makeup is manual by resolved title; match bypassed loudness.
Dry by design: no send.set calls; ducking/MS/multiband/limiting stay manual.
